name: Champion of Freyja
body:
Sex is the pinnacle of sharing. It conquers language barriers, soothes emotional wounds, and creates moments of pure bliss. To be another’s outlet for physical intimacy is considered an honor by Freyja’s devotees.

Champions of Freyja are sometimes known as Champions of the Perfect Companion since they learn secret methods of pleasuring and know the value of their self-worth. Most importantly, these champions cultivate relationships, regardless of whether they are sexual in nature or not. Perfect Companions endeavor to bring joy to their companions, anticipate their needs, foster their well-being, and learn their preferences whether their companion is a spouse, friend, coworker, or casual dalliance. These champions are sometimes called hetairas in Greece.

Background. Many Champions of Freyja began their careers as the spouse or close friend of a warrior or mystic. They adopt their companion’s interests and sometimes surpass them in ability. A few of Freyja’s champions begin as rogues with magical aptitude.
Ancestries. Freyja’s followers are usually human, though giant kin and elves are also found among them.
Role. Champions of Freyja combine magic and martial skills, bringing many surprises and options to a battle. They may also serve as seers or faithful adventuring companions. The champion’s enhanced spell list grants them additional flexibility in a support role as well.
Religion. Champions of Freyja are always devoted to Freyja and her doctrine. This doesn’t preclude champions from honoring or worshiping other deities, but it does mean they hold Freyja above all others.
Alignment. Champions of Freyja follow a strict code of support, understanding, and companionship. Their goddess emphasizes the importance of relationships, loyalty, and magical aspects of life. For these reasons Champions of Freyja must be either Lawful Good or Neutral Good.
Adventures. A Champion of Freyja may be driven by a profound sense of duty and the pursuit of divine purpose. Perhaps a grave threat has befallen the kingdoms, endangering the delicate relationships that Freyja defends.

Motivated by an unyielding desire to protect the innocent and restore harmony, the Freyjanaut sets forth on a perilous journey. Alternatively, a vision or mystical sign from Freyja herself might reveal a hidden relic or ancient knowledge crucial to the well-being of the kingdoms.

Whatever the catalyst, the Champion of Freyja’s sense of purpose, unwavering loyalty, and connection to Freyja serves as a beacon, propelling her from the comforts of home into the realms of adventure.

Promises

The following are the sacred promises made by a Champion of the Perfect Companion:

Companionship… I will be engaging on a mental, emotional, and physical level.
Communication… Love is its own language—I will be a master of verbal and non-verbal communication.
Culture… I will perfect my social etiquette. I will be sensitive to and considerate of my companions.
Requirements

To qualify to become a Champion of Freyja, a character must fulfill all the following criteria.

Base Attack Bonus: +3
Skills: Knowledge (arcana) 3 ranks, Knowledge (religion) 3 ranks
Alignment: Lawful Good or Neutral Good
Class Skills

The Champion of Freyja’s class skills are Craft (Int), Diplomacy (Cha), Heal (Wis), Intimidate (Cha), Knowledge (arcana) (Int), Knowledge (local) (Int), Knowledge (religion) (Int), Linguistics (Int), Perception (Wis), Perform (Cha), Profession (Wis), Sense Motive (Wis), and Spellcraft (Int)

Skill Ranks at Each Level: 4 + Int modifier

Hit Die: d10

Class Features

All of the following are class features of the Champion of Freyja.

Show of Nonaggression

A Champion of Freyja gains proficiency with light and medium armor and with their choice of four of the following weapons: cestus, dagger, dart, light club (baton), light hammer, hand axe, knife, sickle, punching dagger. A champion gains Improved Unarmed Strike as a bonus feat and applies her Dexterity modifier rather than her Strength modifier on unarmed attack rolls and attack rolls made with the four weapons selected above.

When unarmored, not using a shield, unencumbered, and conscious, the champion adds her Charisma bonus (minimum 1) as a deflection bonus to her AC and CMD. If the Champion of Freyja is wearing light armor or using a shield, she adds half her Charisma modifier instead.

In addition, a Champion of Freyja gains a +1 bonus to her AC and CMD at 4th level. This bonus increases by 1 for every 4 champion or Freyjanaut levels thereafter (up to a maximum of +5). These bonuses to AC apply even against touch attacks, and when the champion is flatfooted. These bonuses are lost if the champion is immobilized or helpless.

Alluring Magic: A Champion of Freyja focuses on gaining cooperation and forging bonds with magic rather than bloodshed. At 1st level, a perfect companion gains the bard’s spellcasting progression and the bard’s base attack bonus progression. A perfect companion’s spell list contains all the spells of the enchantment, illusion, and transmutation schools from the sorcerer/wizard spell list up to 5th level, excluding all else. A perfect companion uses the bard spell tables to determine her base daily spell allotment and her spells known, and like a bard, she can cast any spell she knows without preparing it ahead of time. To learn or cast a spell, a perfect companion must have a Charisma score equal to at least 10 + the spell level. The Difficulty Class for a saving throw against a Champion of Freyja’s spell is 10 + the spell level + the Champion of Freyja’s Charisma modifier. A champion’s spells are still considered to be divine.

Discerning Listener (Sp)

At 1st level, as a free action, a Champion of Freyja can comprehend languages (as the spell) for a number of rounds per day equal to 3 + her champion level. These rounds do not need to be consecutive.

Close and Personal Combatant: Perfect companions train in close quarters with unobtrusive weapons. Their familiarity with anatomy allows them to place their strikes in particularly vulnerable areas. At 1st level, a perfect companion gains Two-Weapon Fighting as a bonus feat without having to meet the prerequisite. Furthermore, when both of a perfect companion’s hands wield a weapon from her Show of Nonaggression class ability, she further reduces the penalty to hit with her primary hand by 2, decreasing the penalty to 0 for that hand. At 4th level, a perfect companion deals an additional 1d4 points of precision damage with any of her nonaggression weapons. (A target doesn’t need to be flat-footed or flanked for a perfect companion to deal this precision damage and the damage is not multiplied on a critical hit.) This precision damage increases to 2d4 at 10th level. At 7th level, a perfect companion gains Two-Weapon Defense as a bonus feat.

Alluring Aura (Su)

At 3rd level, a perfect companion projects a 60-foot aura around herself that makes her enchantment spells harder to resist. When a perfect companion casts a spell from the enchantment school and her target (or targets) are within her alluring aura, the target takes a -1 circumstance penalty on the saving throw roll against the spell.

Pillow Talk (Ex)

A Champion of the Perfect Companion utilizes what a person wants to hear to resolve disputes amiably. At 3rd level, a perfect companion gains a bonus on Diplomacy and Sense Motive checks equal to 1/2 her perfect companion level.

Seducer’s Senses (Ex)

Perfect companions often operate in the dark, giving them the opportunity to hone their other senses. At 3rd level, a perfect companion gains blindsense with a 10-foot range. At 6th level and again at 9th level, the range increases by +5 feet.

Stunning Caress (Su)

At 4th level, as a standard action, a perfect companion can expend a use of Lay on Hands to make a melee touch attack against a creature. On a successful hit, the target is stunned for 1 round.

Divine Flesh (Sp)

At 5th level, a perfect companion forms a bond with her bare skin. As a standard action, a perfect companion can enhance her Natural Armor bonus by calling upon the aid of her deity. This bond lasts for 1 minute per perfect companion level. When called upon, the deity grants the perfect companion a +1 enhancement bonus to her Natural Armor. For every 3 levels beyond 5th, the perfect companion gains another +1 enhancement bonus to her Natural Armor. A perfect companion can use this ability once per day at 5th level, and one additional time per day at 9th level.
